creator.creatorName: Jared B. Ellenbogen, Mikayla A. Borton

titles.title: Newick Trees for EMERGE methanogen genome tree, and methylotrophic gene trees

descriptions.description:
Newick trees provided for phylogenomic and phylogenetic analyses from Ellenbogen et al. (in prep). The methanogen genome tree (Newick_tree_for_methanogen_genome_tree.suptree) was built using an alignment generated with GTDB-Tk v1.5.0 r202, and the tree made using IQ Tree v1.6.12. All other trees are RAxML gene trees built using ProtPipeliner (https://github.com/TheWrightonLab/Protpipeliner/blob/master/protpipeliner.py) to confirm the functional identity of identified methylotrophic genes from methanogens and bacteria. The names of the Newick trees correspond to relevant gene groupings as discussed in the associated manuscript. FUNDING:
